functionalRequirement: In the Facebook settings menu, the system shall allow the user to delete their saved username and password for Facebook.

identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures precise and reliable geo-location and distance information.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow prospective applicants to research requirements and select relevant services or applications to initiate online.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: Provide a clear, intuitive navigation flow with maximum 3 clicks to access service requirements and selection interface.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Simplifies the process for prospective applicants to find and select services.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Implement context-sensitive help tooltips for each service selection step, accessible via a '?' icon.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides guidance to users during the service research and selection process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Interoperability: Support responsive design compatible with minimum 95% of modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and screen sizes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures accessibility across different devices and browser platforms.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Load service requirements and selection interface within 2 seconds for 99% of user interactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides a responsive and efficient user experience during service research.

functionalRequirement: System shall allow staff members to develop staff reports for publication and distribution.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: Provide a drag-and-drop interface for report content management with auto-save functionality every 3 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances ease of use and prevents data loss during report creation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: Design report creation system with plug-in architecture supporting at least 5 different report template types.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for future extensibility and customization of report generation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain 99.9% uptime for report creation and distribution systems during business hours.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures consistent access to report development tools.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: Implement version control for all reports, tracking changes with author, timestamp, and ability to restore previous versions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides accountability and traceability for report modifications.

functionalRequirement: User shall be guided to a login page after successfully registering, where they can enter their credentials to access the application.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement mandatory multi-factor authentication with options including SMS, email, or authenticator app verification.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances login security beyond basic username and password.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Provide clear password entry guidelines, including minimum 12-character length, complexity requirements, and real-time strength meter.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guides users in creating strong, secure credentials.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Redirect to login page within 500 milliseconds after successful registration.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures a smooth, immediate transition to login after registration.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Maintain login system availability of 99.99% with automatic failover mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents login interruptions and ensures consistent access to the application.

functionalRequirement: System shall ensure that dataset instances of a type created during app deployment start using the new code when a new version of the dataset type is deployed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must support seamless version migration for dataset types with zero downtime, allowing instant switchover to new code versions without manual intervention.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures smooth transitions between dataset type versions with minimal operational disruption.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must preserve data integrity and prevent data loss during dataset type version updates, with automatic rollback capabilities if migration fails.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for maintaining data consistency during version deployments.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Version migration for dataset instances must complete within 500 milliseconds for datasets up to 10,000 records.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Minimizes performance impact when updating dataset type implementations.

functionalRequirement: The system shall allow site administrators to create news articles with designated publishing dates and expiry dates.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support scheduling for 100% of news article publication and expiration scenarios, including past, present, and future dates.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures full coverage of article scheduling capabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Only authenticated site administrators with appropriate role-based access control (RBAC) shall be able to create and modify news article scheduling.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects the content management system from unauthorized modifications.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must validate and prevent invalid date ranges, such as expiry dates before publishing dates, with clear error messages.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps administrators avoid scheduling mistakes through proactive validation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The article scheduling system must have 99.99% uptime to ensure consistent content management.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for maintaining reliable content publication processes.

functionalRequirement: User shall be able to create a Gmail account by providing personal details like name, gender, password, mobile number, and location.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: All personal information must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 encryption with key rotation every 90 days.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive user personal information from unauthorized access.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Implement password strength requirements including minimum 12 characters, mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances account security during account creation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: Provide real-time validation for each input field with specific error messages for invalid entries (e.g., incorrect mobile number format, weak password).
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guides users through accurate account creation process.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: Account creation process must be available 99.99% of the time with automatic failover mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can always create accounts without interruption.

functionalRequirement: A surface app page shall provide a customer with all customer system functionality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The surface app page must load completely within 2 seconds and provide a responsive design that adapts to screen sizes from 320px to 4K displays.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures accessibility and engagement across different devices.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The page must support dynamic content loading and feature toggling for at least 95% of system functionalities without full page reloads.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for flexible and dynamic user interface adaptation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The surface app page must consume no more than 100 MB of browser memory and maintain CPU usage below 20% during typical interactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents performance degradation and ensures smooth user experience.

functionalRequirement: System shall display information and settings related to the required setting based on user input.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Provide context-sensitive help tooltips for each setting, explaining its purpose and potential impacts within 500 milliseconds of user hover.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances user understanding of system settings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Settings and related information must be retrieved and displayed within 300 milliseconds for 99% of user queries.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures responsive and quick access to system settings.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support displaying 100% of relevant settings and information for each user input scenario.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Guarantees comprehensive information presentation based on user context.

functionalRequirement: If the validation fails, system shall prompt "Wrong OTP".

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must display the OTP error message in a clear, readable font with high contrast (minimum WCAG 2.1 AA color contrast ratio of 4.5:1) within 0.5 seconds of validation failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can quickly and clearly understand the reason for OTP validation failure.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: The system must log each OTP validation attempt, capturing timestamp, user ID, and result (success/failure) with immutable audit trail.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides security tracking for authentication attempts and potential fraud detection.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must allow a maximum of 3 consecutive OTP validation attempts before temporarily blocking the user account for 15 minutes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents brute force attacks while maintaining user accessibility.

functionalRequirement: Information on remaining job posting time and CV access shall be reportable

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must provide 100% accurate reporting of remaining job posting time and CV access status for all active job postings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive and reliable reporting of critical job application information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must generate reports on job posting time and CV access within 2 seconds for queries involving up to 500 concurrent job postings.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides timely access to important job application tracking information.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: The reporting interface must display remaining job posting time in a clear, human-readable format (e.g., "2 days, 5 hours remaining") with countdown timer.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Helps users easily understand and track job posting deadlines.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: The reporting system must support export of job posting and CV access reports in at least three standard formats (CSV, PDF, XML) for further analysis.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables flexible data extraction and analysis of job posting information.
